title: MCP Admission Request
description: Input to scripts/mcp_admission_audit.mjs. Describes a third-party MCP server's install/admission state, whether quarantine exit is being requested, team policy, and whether its write tools route through daemon policy.

name.description: Human-readable name of the MCP server under review, e.g. 'github-mcp' or 'acme-widgets-mcp'.

manifestPresent.description: Whether the server publishes a manifest describing itself, its tools, and their side effects.

provenance.description: Whether the server's package/binary is cryptographically signed, known-unsigned, or of unknown origin.

signatureVerified.description: Whether the signature (if provenance is 'signed') has actually been checked against a trusted key, not merely claimed.

permissionScope.description: The declared capability/permission scope this server requests.

sandboxSmokeTest.description: Result of running the server inside a sandbox smoke test before granting live capability.

healthCheck.description: Whether a runtime health check (e.g. 'pd doctor') is wired up for this server.

hasDisableRepairUninstall.description: Whether disable, repair, and uninstall affordances all exist for this server.

usageTrace.description: Whether the server's tool invocations are captured in a usage/failure trace.

exitRequested.description: Whether admission is requesting this server exit quarantine and run for real, as opposed to remaining under review.

teamPolicy.description: The team's admission policy for this server: auto-allow, require approval, hard block, or no policy set at all.

writeToolsRouteThroughDaemonPolicy.description: Whether every write-capable tool this server exposes is routed through daemon policy rather than executing directly.
